'''Shock grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that was issued to [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]]. This grenade was also used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]].
